UPDATE "ASiruk".interview_questions
SET original_text = CASE
        WHEN original_text IS NULL AND {{ $json.has_text }} THEN question_text
        ELSE original_text
    END,
    question_text = CASE
        WHEN {{ $json.has_text }} THEN '{{ $json.question_text }}'
        ELSE question_text
    END,
    reference_answer = CASE
        WHEN {{ $json.has_ref }} THEN '{{ $json.reference_answer }}'
        ELSE reference_answer
    END,
    status           = '{{ $json.status }}',
    reviewer_comment = NULLIF('{{ $json.comment }}', ''),
    reviewed_by      = {{ $json.or_id === null ? 'NULL' : $json.or_id }},
    reviewed_at      = now()
WHERE id = {{ $json.question_id }}
RETURNING id AS question_id, status, competency_id,
          (original_text IS NOT NULL AND original_text <> question_text) AS был_отредактирован;

SELECT c.id AS competency_id,
       c.name,
       count(q.id) FILTER (WHERE q.status = 'approved') AS осталось_одобренных,
       CASE WHEN count(q.id) FILTER (WHERE q.status = 'approved') = 0
            THEN 'нет одобренных вопросов' ELSE 'ок' END AS предупреждение
FROM "ASiruk".competencies c
LEFT JOIN "ASiruk".interview_questions q ON q.competency_id = c.id
WHERE c.id = (SELECT competency_id FROM "ASiruk".interview_questions
              WHERE id = {{ $('1. Разобрать').first().json.question_id }})
GROUP BY c.id, c.name;
